owner_acceptance_basis: WUBRG golden semantic contract and VM-610 explicit final gate
default_rule_preserved: Every promoted non-golden SIRF contract must retain exact Start Here / What to Look For taxonomy equality. This WUBRG-only contract does not generalize or weaken that rule.

start_here.principal_responsibility: Turn all-five access into a buildable first decision by pairing mana-system readiness with a chosen deck purpose.
start_here.identity_specific_item_role: Construction prerequisite: the player must decide whether the mana system can support the chosen all-five plan before choosing cards.

what_to_look_for.principal_responsibility: Name observable deck, commander, and card signals that explain why all five colors are present.
what_to_look_for.identity_specific_item_role: Browsing signal: a creature type, commander, or typal payoff spanning the color pie is visible evidence for an all-five deck purpose.

surface_role_distinction: Fixing & Ramp belongs to Start Here because it changes the player's construction sequence; Five-Color Typal belongs to What to Look For because it is an observable browsing signal. The shared items are used once to choose a plan and once to recognize evidence for that plan. The two surfaces therefore do not make substantially the same claim for the same purpose.
